additional_info.subject: ID0453552-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R4 170001816] Out of order CRM:02678000470
additional_info.body:
Hello Chlöe, good morning. I hope you are doing well.
I checked this charger with the error, it was related to the LEM meter of DC2 and had the following error: "timeSyncStatusIsOk":false
The only thing I did was remove the LEM from the configuration and re-add it, and now it's working. Must likely there was a software related error and after the reset it worked.
Let me know if everything is good from your side and I can close the ticket.
Thanks a lot!
Best regards,
Francisco
